title: Updating the Runs-Remaining Register
statement: For a register state $\sigma$ and a natural number $y$, replacing coordinate $6$ of its register vector by $y$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by setting its runs-remaining field to $y$.
replaced:
Let a register record have its 15 natural-number coordinates stored in order as a
vector, with coordinate 6 equal to its runs-left field. Replacing coordinate 6 of this
vector by a natural number $y$ gives the vector of the record obtained by replacing its
runs-left field by $y$.
